1) Can you confirm the official period covered by the report and whether there were any retrospective adjustments to the period boundaries?

   - User & service principal access lists as of 2026-06-30

Our auditor (Ledger Audit) prefers checksummed ZIPs and an MD5 or SHA256. If you can indicate the expected delivery mechanism and a suggested download window, that would help schedule their testing. Also, if there's any required Non-Disclosure or guest onboarding steps, please flag.
